title: D&D 5e Subclass Import
description: A schema for importing custom subclasses into the Heroes Guild Character Sheet. Each subclass belongs to a parent class and provides features at specific levels. GMs and LLMs can use this schema to author subclass data that integrates with the character creator.

subclasses.description: An array of subclass definitions to import.

name.description: The display name of the subclass (e.g. 'Champion', 'Circle of the Moon').
name.errorMessage: Subclass name must be a non-empty string.

parentClass.description: The name of the parent class this subclass belongs to (e.g. 'Fighter', 'Druid'). This must match a class name defined in the rules compendium.
parentClass.errorMessage: Parent class must be a non-empty string.

description.description: Flavour text describing the subclass archetype.

features.description: The features granted by this subclass. Each feature becomes available at the specified level.

name.description: The display name of the feature (e.g. 'Improved Critical', 'Combat Superiority').
name.errorMessage: Feature name must be a non-empty string.

level.description: The effective character level at which this feature is granted (1-20). For the West Marches tier system, features with level ≤ 3 are Tier 1, level ≤ 6 are Tier 2, level ≤ 10 are Tier 3.
level.errorMessage: Feature level must be an integer between 1 and 20.

description.description: The full rules text for this feature. Markdown formatting is supported.
description.errorMessage: Feature description must be a non-empty string.

features.errorMessage: Subclass must have at least one feature.

required.subclasses: The root object must contain a 'subclasses' array.
